name: Insurance and Securities Layering
description: Use of insurance products and securities markets to place and layer funds, for example single-premium policies cancelled early, or trading, wash trades and account transfers that obscure source and ownership.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: Life Insurance Sector (2018)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Securities Sector (2009)
IAIS, Application Paper on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2013; revised 2021)

exposure.rationale: Single-premium policy cancellation and securities trading layering through brokers.

indicators.name: Large single premium paid then early surrender
indicators.canon: Large single premium paid then early surrender
indicators.desc: Policy funded with lump sum and cancelled soon after, with refund to third party.
indicators.ctx: Policy funded with lump sum and cancelled soon after, with refund to third party.

indicators.name: Premiums paid by unrelated third parties
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Payers have no insurable interest or link.

indicators.name: Policy loans or assignments to third parties
indicators.canon: Policy loans or assignments to third parties
indicators.desc: Rapid loans, assignments or beneficiary changes.
indicators.ctx: Rapid loans, assignments or beneficiary changes.

indicators.name: Overfunded policies and partial withdrawals
indicators.desc: Paid in excess of required premium then withdrawn.
indicators.ctx: Paid in excess of required premium then withdrawn.

indicators.name: Wash or matched trades between connected accounts
indicators.canon: Wash or matched trades between connected parties
indicators.desc: Assets or securities are traded repeatedly between linked accounts or wallets at unrealistic prices.
indicators.ctx: Same securities traded between related accounts at unrealistic prices.

indicators.name: Securities deposited then transferred out without trading
indicators.canon: Securities deposited then transferred out without trading
indicators.desc: Shares deposited and moved with no market activity.
indicators.ctx: Shares deposited and moved with no market activity.

indicators.name: Trading in low-liquidity securities with unrelated parties
indicators.canon: Trading in low-liquidity securities with unrelated parties
indicators.desc: Illiquid instruments used to move value.
indicators.ctx: Illiquid instruments used to move value.

indicators.name: Use of omnibus or nominee accounts
indicators.canon: Use of omnibus or nominee accounts
indicators.desc: Positions hidden via omnibus or nominee structure.
indicators.ctx: Positions hidden via omnibus or nominee structure.

indicators.name: Customer indifferent to investment performance or fees
indicators.canon: Customer indifferent to cost, return or value
indicators.desc: Customer readily accepts poor terms, fees, losses, penalties or prices, showing little interest in performance, provenance or negotiation.
